result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It makes Type I the default and confirms Customer ownership of Customer data, but it does not expressly assign ownership of deliverables or work product to Customer. The Type II licence remains limited to use within Customer’s US-only Enterprise and does not include modification, derivative-work or sublicensing rights, so it is narrower than both the preferred and fallback positions. The margin comment identifies these defects but does not cure them. The unexplained reordering, undefined use of “Content,” and fragmented Type I licence language also reduce drafting quality and are unnecessary.
